overallSummary: Fabio Giglietto maintains a highly targeted, professional social media presence across academic and research-focused niches on LinkedIn, Bluesky, and Mastodon. With a combined following of 3,580, his content focuses heavily on computational social science, disinformation, and research achievements. Engagement is exceptionally strong across all platforms, reflecting a highly dedicated audience of peers, students, and collaborators who actively interact with his publications, tool updates, and career opportunities.

contentThemes.description: Research updates, publications, and tools (like CooRnet v2.0) designed to detect and study coordinated link-sharing and information operations.
Recruitment posts seeking postdocs and PhD students for computational social science projects.
High-profile announcements regarding newly awarded research grants and upcoming conference presentations.

recommendations: Prioritize Bluesky for academic community outreach and discussion, as it exhibits the highest overall engagement rate per follower (6.14% average).
Use LinkedIn strategically for high-reach corporate and professional milestones, such as hiring and grant announcements, where absolute visibility is maximized.
Promote technical updates and open-source tool releases (e.g., CooRnet) on Mastodon to engage the developer and academic communities interested in platform methodologies.
Incorporate more rich media, links, or direct calls-to-action on Mastodon to elevate the engagement rates closer to Bluesky levels.

platformInsights.bluesky: Bluesky serves as the most interactive platform, achieving a 6.14% average engagement rate. It is highly effective for rapid dissemination of new research papers and academic opportunities.
platformInsights.mastodon: Mastodon provides steady engagement (4.55% average ER) from a highly specialized audience. Content focusing on tools and methodological discussions performs best here.
platformInsights.linkedin: LinkedIn has the largest audience (1,850 followers) and generates the highest absolute engagement volume. It is ideal for professional milestones like grant wins and postdoctoral recruitment.
